title: The exact region determined by Spearman's footrule, Gini's gamma and Kendall's tau
summary: Concordance measures are used to express the degree of association between random variables. Practitioners may use several distinct concordance measures to narrow the space of possible dependence structures. Consequently, the relations between different (weak) concordance measures have been extensively studied in recent years. The goal of this paper is to study the relation between Kendall's tau, Gini's gamma and Spearman's footrule.
